verdict.rationale: Puzzle exposes an API for embedded accounting and bookkeeping data (puzzle-docs-1, puzzle-docs-42) plus CSV/journal bulk import tools, but there is no documentation claiming or demonstrating that every UI action (invoicing, reconciliation, categorization rules, AI Close workflows) is exposed via the API, and a probe for an OpenAPI/swagger spec returned 404s, suggesting the API surface is not fully public or documented. missing for 10: explicit API-UI parity documentation, public OpenAPI spec, evidence of invoice creation/reconciliation/AI Close being API-accessible.
